title: Sum of Two Integers
description: Given two integers a and b, return their sum without using the + or - operators.

reference.use_case: Adding two numbers using only logic operations, which is how addition is implemented in digital hardware.
system_examples: CPU arithmetic logic units — ripple-carry and carry-lookahead adders built from logic gates
Arbitrary-precision libraries (e.g. GMP) — propagating carries across multi-word integers
FPGA/HDL design — implementing custom adders in Verilog or VHDL
reference.explanation: XOR gives the sum without carries and AND shifted left gives the carries; repeating until no carry remains adds the numbers, mirroring a hardware adder. In Python you must mask to 32 bits to emulate fixed-width overflow. The practical value is understanding carry propagation in hardware arithmetic.
